profile.headline: Fast Learner | Ready to Explore
profile.summary:
Alex is a Full Stack Software Engineer with a Bachelor's degree focused in Computer Science from the California Polytechnic State University, San Luis Obispo.

I was trained to be a fast learner, and always be ready to adopt new technology.
When not coding, I enjoy working in other engineering projects such as: mechanical (auto repair) and home improvement.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed and customized Salesforce applications for partners in both Classic and Lightning versions using Apex coding language and Visualforce page. 
Administrated Salesforce setting (sharing rules, roles, profiles & users permission) to ensure data integrity.
Designed and implemented multiple REST/ SOAP APIs for internal and external. Provide reliable and smooth data transfer between Salesforce orgs, or Salesforce with Mobile apps, web app, and partners system. 
Built automated business processes using Salesforce automation tools such as Schedule Jobs and Triggers to send text SMS or email.
Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues. Proficiency in using SOQL, Salesforce reports, Postman, code review, etc… to identify the root cause.
Integrated external tools into Salesforce such as: Twilio, Fedex, wooCommerce x Zapier.

positions.title: Web Application Developer
positions.description:
- Full stack web app developer
- Participating in multiple projects providing software for customers in Europe, Asia, and Australia.
- Working with multiple coding languages: PHP, Javascript, Coffee-script, Typescript, SQL, CSS, HTML.
- Having hands-on experiences with multiple frameworks, libraries, and tools: CodeIgniter, Angular4, Bootstrap, jQuery, Node.js, Docker.
- Applied project management skills and tool (Git, Trello, Jira, Slack) to document customer requirements, turn them into actionable units of work and forecast timeline for completion.
- Engineered features from development, testing, deployment and operations. 
- Mentored teammates on technical subjects such as REST API specification and pair programming, which decreased the time to deliver the product.

positions.title: Math tutor
positions.description:
- Provided expert knowledge to students with questions related to Physics and Math.
- Provided learning support to 100's of students by creating math and physics problems to help with advanced topics.

projects.title: Clue
projects.description:
Clue is an online multiplayer card game. There is a runaway criminal. Player's mission is to identify the suspect's name, his vehicle, and his driving destination; using clues on each card.

Clue game can run on different platforms: Windows, Linux, Mac OS.
It has various theme to choose.
It is available in different languages: English, Spanish.

projects.title: Simple Music Player
projects.description: SM Player is an Android Application, which is a .mp3 music player for listeners who just want to play their songs without all the extraneous features. It sticks to the basics, allowing users to get straight to creating playlists and playing music.
